[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2853" width="100%"]

resolved.title: 城市旅游亮点记录
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你是个旅游狂魔，去过很多不同国家的城市，并将去过的城市记录在了表**cities**中:

![](/content/assets/e37ead99879782463b78.jpeg)

字段含义:
- `name` : 城市名
- `country`: 国家
- `population`: 人口数量

现在，你需要在表**cities**中添加一个新列**AttractivePlace**，专门记录某个城市对你最有吸引力的地方，并更新为如下值：

- 'Belem Tower' 对城市**Lisbon**
- 'Plaza Mayor' 对城市**Madrid**
- 'Eiffel Tower'对城市**Paris**

然后查询并显示所有数据。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]ALTER TABLE[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Jessica has a list of the cities she has visited:
[b]cities[/b][img id="4509" width="100%"]
She is going to add the most attractive places she visited in each of the cities.
[b]Add[/b] a new column 'AttractivePlace' and [b]update[/b] the values:
- 'Belem Tower' for Lisbon
- 'Plaza Mayor' for Madrid
- 'Eiffel Tower' for Paris

Then show the resulting table.
[note]Use the [b]ALTER TABLE[/b] command to add a new column and the UPDATE command to update the values of the newly generated fields.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用**ALTER TABLE**命令添加新列，使用**UPDATE**命令更新字段值。

resolved.title: 删除列 DROP COLUMN
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Dropping[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The following SQL code demonstrates how to delete the column named [i]DateOfBirth [/i]in the People table.[code format="sql" codeId="3077"][b]ALTER TABLE[/b] People 
[b]DROP COLUMN[/b] DateOfBirth;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]The People table will now look like this:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2852" width="100%"]
[note]The column, along with all of its data, will be completely removed from the table.[/note]
[s0l0!-header]To delete the entire table, use the [b]DROP TABLE[/b] command:[/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" ][b]DROP TABLE[/b] People;[/code]
[note]Be careful when dropping a table. Deleting a table will result in the complete loss of the information stored in the table![/note]

resolved.title: 重命名 RENAME
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Renaming[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The ALTER TABLE command is also used to rename columns: [code format="sql" codeId="3082"]ALTER TABLE People
RENAME FirstName TO name;[/code]
This query will rename the column called FirstName to name.

[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2854" width="100%"]
[s0l0!-header][b]Renaming Tables[/b][/s0l0!-header] 

You can rename the entire table using the [b]RENAME [/b]command: [code format="sql" ][b]RENAME TABLE[/b] People [b]TO [/b]Users;[/code]
[note]This will rename the table People to Users.[/note]
